assumptions: Delta_first is the pooled share over all marker-family sessions, so the exact binomial runs at the full n. If the counterbalanced Delta is instead computed within each map (n/2 each) and then combined, effective n falls and every number here moves.
MDE is quoted at power 0.8; PROPOSAL-h declares a power floor for H1 but not for MDE_verdict itself. That convention belongs in LOCK-h.
H1's power is computed two-sided because its gate is on |Delta_first|; a one-sided reading would inflate the power.
The binomial MDE ignores the control-envelope and sign-lock conjuncts, both of which can only make the verdict harder.
decides_nothing: Code delivers arithmetic; LOCK-h.md is authored by the design instance.
